## Validation

- [ ] I tested the affected public pages or API routes.
- [ ] Automated checks pass.
- [ ] No credentials, access tokens, private case records, housing evidence, legal correspondence, resident data, or personal information are included.
- [ ] This change stays within the public website and brand-system boundary.
- [ ] Analytics or tracking changes document the event names and consent/privacy impact.
- [ ] Security, authentication, evidence, or deployment changes include a rollback plan.
